title: Future Juice Lemon Cheesecake Deluxe  Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Future Juice’s Lemon Cheesecake Deluxe is a rich and zesty dessert blend that layers smooth, tangy Lemon with the creamy indulgence of classic Cheesecake. The bright citrus top note delivers a refreshing burst of Lemon, perfectly balanced by the velvety texture of Cheesecake filling. A buttery Biscuit base rounds out the flavour, adding a warm, crumbly depth that lingers with every puff. Blended at 70% VG / 30% PG, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and full-bodied flavour. Ideal for high-powered vape kits and sub-ohm tanks, it offers a smooth and satisfying dessert-inspired vape. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, while nic salt shots offer a milder throat hit compared to freebase nicotine. Future Juice is a UK-based e-liquid manufacturer dedicated to crafting premium blends with bold, layered flavours. Their shortfill range combines classic dessert and fruit-inspired profiles, designed for vapers who enjoy rich, satisfying e-liquids.
